title: The 6 Principles of Minimum Viable Replacement (MVR) | HatchWorks AI
description: Looking to modernize your legacy systems without breaking the bank? Introducing Minimum Viable Replacement (MVR) - a smart and incremental modernization strategy that upgrades only the essential components of your existing system. Discover the 6 principles that guide the MVR approach.
